title: ProjectPortfolioSettingCompact
description: A project portfolio setting represents the relationship between a project and a portfolio, including configuration such as access control inheritance.

gid.description: Globally unique identifier of the resource, as a string.

resource_type.description: The base type of this resource.

project.description: The project associated with this setting.

portfolio.description: The portfolio associated with this setting.

is_access_control_inherited.description: When true, the portfolio members gain access to the project.
